_note: Query 10: aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-03-05,End=2026-05-06 --granularity DAILY --metrics AmortizedCost UnblendedCost UsageQuantity --filter '{"And":[{"Dimensions":{"Key":"SERVICE","Values":["Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud - Compute"]}},{"Dimensions":{"Key":"RECORD_TYPE","Values":["Usage","DiscountedUsage","SavingsPlanCoveredUsage"]}}]}' --group-by Type=DIMENSION,Key=USAGE_TYPE Type=DIMENSION,Key=RECORD_TYPE. Drill into the top-delta service; grouping by RECORD_TYPE as well shows HOW each usage type is billed. The rows sum to the EC2 line of billing-data.json for every day, in both metrics. Read the r5 rows: until 2026-04-15 r5.4xlarge is 496.03 h of SavingsPlanCoveredUsage (amortized 360.00 = the plan's effective cost; unblended 500.00 = on-demand value) plus 39.68 h of on-demand Usage (40.00); from 2026-04-16 the same 535.71 h is all on-demand Usage (540.00). Hours are unchanged: only the rate changed. Bill-derived p3 rate = Usage cost / hours = 12.24 USD per instance-hour.
